review_state: C21 physical identity assembly-and-owner supported; R4 west-endpoint to C21 lower contact remains an unpromoted candidate

assembly.observation: C21 is explicitly labelled as a vertical part directly below R20, left of D96 and right of D105; R19 is separately labelled farther below.

owner.observation: Both overlapping July views show the green vertical dipped part between the R20-position red body and D96, matching the C21 assembly footprint. The upper green lead visibly shares F.Cu with the red body lower lead; the coated lower green lead crosses above C92 right strip and lands separately near D96. No legible 24 code or measured capacitor value is available.

r4_endpoint_candidate.limit: The two D13-based projections and the closer D105 crosscheck leave roughly 37-41 px horizontal separation from the R4 trace endpoint. This is too loose for same-hole promotion outside the package frame. Exact sheet 1 puts R4 right on RESIN and one C21 lead on ground, but the owner photos do not establish which green lead is which or the R20-position body lead polarity. A real R4-to-C21-lower join would require rechecking those assignments against direct continuity, not rejecting the photo candidate by schematic expectation.
r4_endpoint_candidate.next_test: With power off, probe R4 right against the actual lower C21 joint and D13.5 separately; if a join appears, verify component and net identities before changing the model.

D105_local_crosscheck.observation: The closer D105 row improves the projected green-lower-contact vertical match to about 14 px, but leaves roughly 37 px horizontal separation from the R4-route joint (2380,1440). Both fits extrapolate beyond the right edge of D105, so neither proves the same hole.

decision: Promote the green body identity to factory C21 by unique assembly position and two owner views. Keep its lead numbers, capacitance marking, lower lead rail, and possible R4 endpoint join open.
